key_points: Berkshire bought full control of Limekiln’s MF1 multifamily lending stake, ending an 8‑year JV.
Greg Abel‑led Berkshire repurchased $4.5 bn of stock last quarter, signaling continued capital return.
Historical pattern shows Berkshire often outperforms after trailing the S&P 500 by ~10 pts.
Apple remains Berkshire’s largest holding, reinforcing the conglomerate’s quality bias.
No material earnings surprise or guidance change; headlines are largely commentary.
